recipes.description: Read and write files via the MCP filesystem server. Choose an access tier: sandbox (default harness workspace), project (one directory you pick), or full (your entire home directory and its subtrees). The model gets read_file, write_file, list_directory, create_directory, move_file, and search_files tools scoped to the directories you allow.

config_options.name: access_tier
config_options.description: sandbox = default harness workspace only (safest); project = one directory you choose (e.g. a code repo); full = your entire home directory and everything below it (use with care).

config_options.name: allowed_directories
config_options.description: Directories the model is allowed to read and write. For sandbox, the default workspace is created automatically. For project, add your project root. For full, add your home directory (e.g. ~/). Add additional paths as needed.
